title: Black Founders Raised $643M in Q1 2026 — Highest Since 2022. But 0.32% of Total VC. Read That Again
summary: Black-founded startups hit $643M across 34 deals — led by SambaNova's $350M AI hardware round. But that's still 0.32% of the $252B raised by US startups this year. The funding gap isn't closing. It's just getting better optics.

title: SambaNova Just Raised $350M for AI Chips and Their CEO Is a Black Stanford PhD. Where's the Press Conference?
summary: SambaNova Systems, founded by Rodrigo Liang and Kunle Olukotun (a Nigerian-American Stanford professor), raised a $350M Series E bringing total funding to $1.5B. An AI chip company competing with NVIDIA. Founded by a Black man. Why aren't we talking about this more?

title: AI Data Centers Are Being Built in Black Neighborhoods Without Community Consent. Essence and KQED Investigated
summary: DeKalb County extended its moratorium on data centers to June 2026 after developers targeted predominantly Black suburbs. These facilities demand enormous electricity, water, and land — in communities that had no say. The AI boom has a geography problem.

title: Trump's AI Executive Order Removes Safety Guardrails. Here's What That Actually Means for Communities Already Getting Surveilled
summary: The new executive order prioritizes 'innovation' over safety testing. Translation: companies can deploy AI systems without bias audits. If you're already being misidentified by facial recognition, this just got worse.

title: Facial Recognition Misidentifies Black Faces 5-10x More Often Than White Faces. CMU Africa Is Building the Fix
summary: Carnegie Mellon University Africa developed a system that adapts image brightness and contrast for darker skin tones — improving accuracy while being thousands of times smaller and cheaper than deep learning systems. The technology to fix bias exists. The question is who deploys it.

title: From Facial Recognition Misfires to Discriminatory Hiring: AI's Racial Bias Is a Feature, Not a Bug
summary: AI systems learn from data — and that data reflects society's biases. When you train an algorithm on a flawed history, it replicates those injustices. Disproportionate policing data in, disproportionate policing out. A full investigation.

title: Black Tech Saturdays x University of Michigan Launch Free AI Fluency Course in Detroit. This Is How You Bridge the Gap
summary: One of the first partnerships between a Black-founded community tech org and a major research university at this scale. Free AI classes in Detroit, Saturday mornings, in person. Teaching people how AI works AND how to make money with it.

title: HillmanTok University: 400+ Free Courses From Black Educators — Netflix Partnership — No Tuition, No Application
summary: Started when Dr. Leah Barlow's NC A&T TikTok went viral. Now it's 400+ subjects taught by Black educators, a Netflix streaming partnership, and zero cost. Courses range from Forensic Pathology to AI Ethics to 'We Got Food at Home.' Register at edu.thehillmantok.com.

title: DeepLearning.AI Has 50+ Free Short Courses on AI, LLMs, RAG, Agents, and Fine-Tuning. Here Are the 10 That Actually Matter
summary: Andrew Ng's platform keeps dropping courses. Most are 1-3 hours and completely free. We tested all 50+ and these 10 will actually change your career trajectory. Start with 'ChatGPT Prompt Engineering for Developers' and work down.

title: Google Black Founders Fund 2026 — Up to $150K Non-Dilutive for Black-Led Startups — Applications Open NOW
summary: Non-dilutive means they don't take equity. Free money plus Google Cloud credits, mentorship, and network access. If you have a startup and you're not applying, who trained you?

title: 5 Black Founders Using AI to Disrupt Industries Right Now — And How They Built Their First Products
summary: From AI-native insurance (Harper, $47M Series A) to sports prediction markets (Noviq, $75M Series B) — real founders, real revenue, real playbooks you can learn from.

title: VC Gave Black Founders 0.32% of $252 Billion in 2026. Here's Why Bootstrap > VC for Most of Us Right Now
summary: The data is clear: VC isn't built for us at scale. But AI tools just made bootstrapping 10x cheaper. Free LLMs, $0 infrastructure, global distribution. The playbook has changed.

title: Paper Breakdown: 'Whose Bias Gets Coded? Psychology's Role in Decolonizing AI' — The Paper That Connects Colonialism to Your Algorithm
summary: Published in NIH/PubMed. Argues that AI bias isn't a technical problem — it's a colonial one. The same power structures that built empires are now building algorithms. Heavy. Necessary. Required reading.

title: Paper Breakdown: 'AI and Blackness — Towards Moving Beyond Bias and Representation' (ArXiv) — The Framework We've Been Needing
summary: Goes beyond 'fix the bias' to ask deeper questions about AI's relationship to Blackness itself. Not just representation in datasets — but ontological questions about what AI 'sees' when it processes Black bodies, culture, and language.

title: Detroit Input: Black Tech Saturdays x UMich AI Fluency Program — Free, In Person, Saturday Mornings at Newlab
summary: First-of-its-kind partnership between a Black-founded tech org and a major research university. Teaching AI fundamentals plus how to generate income with AI. Classes started June 6 at Michigan Central.

title: Google Black Founders Fund — Non-Dilutive Grants Up to $150K + Cloud Credits + Mentorship — Open for 2026
summary: Annual program providing cash grants (no equity taken), Google Cloud credits, and hands-on support. Past recipients include companies across AI, fintech, health tech, and education.

title: Ripple Report: AI Data Center Boom → Black Neighborhoods Targeted → Energy Costs Rise → Environmental Justice Crisis
summary: The chain: Tech companies need data centers → cheap land in Black suburbs → massive electricity draw → utility bills rise for residents → environmental burden concentrated in communities with least political power. Full analysis inside.

title: Trump's AI Executive Order Removes Safety Testing Requirements — What This Means for Communities Already Being Surveilled by AI
summary: The order prioritizes 'American AI dominance' over safety and bias testing. Companies can now deploy AI systems without government-mandated audits. If facial recognition already misidentifies Black faces 5-10x more, removing oversight makes it worse, not better.
